Ölüdeniz Paragliding in a Nutshell

Ölüdeniz is the world's #1 tandem paragliding destination. Over 100,000 flights annually from Babadağ Mountain (1,960m), landing on Belcekiz Beach overlooking the Blue Lagoon. No experience needed — your THK-licensed pilot handles everything.

Prices at a Glance

See full price breakdown.

  • Professional Tandem: $150/person (pilot + insurance + mountain fee + transfer)
  • 4K Media Bundle: $190/person (above + GoPro video + 100 photos)
  • VIP Private Flight: $350/person (private scheduling, premium pilot, champagne)
  • Sunset Flight: $220/person (golden hour, limited to 4 pilots/day)

Coming from Another City?

  • From Fethiye — free hotel pickup, 40 min to launch
  • From Marmaris — day trip available, 2.5h transfer
  • From Antalya — day trip available, 3h transfer
  • From Kaş — 2h transfer, easy day trip

Season & Weather

Flying season: April–November. Best months: July–October. See our weather guide and best time guide for detailed month-by-month advice. Summer flying offers the strongest thermals.
